comparison.objective: Adjust an enclosure compression latch's threaded grip length while unloaded, then close its wing cam to clamp the enclosure.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine threaded adjustment, latching, and force/retention control substantially overlap with adjust-and-lock primitives. It lacks recessed hex-key engagement and closed-loop impact-response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Gap below 1 mm, clamp above 20 N, handle at least 175 degrees for 20 continuous seconds without contact; the body does not expose the complete partial-credit rubric.
comparison.reason: Closest mechanical analogue, but it tests selecting static latch geometry and cam closure; the candidate tests damping selection from repeated carriage dynamics and setscrew retention.
